The Authentic Name

Why aŋramainyu.com is the correct form

Zoroastrian Original

AŋraMainyu

The name in its original Zoroastrian form. The original script is preserved in scholarly transliteration systems.

ASCII Constraint

ANGRAMAINYU

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

AŋraMainyu

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
aŋramainyu.com → xn--aramainyu-bxb.com

The non-ASCII characters in AŋraMainyu are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is AŋraMainyu.

Tier Classification

Why AŋraMainyu is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Zoroastrian original AŋraMainyu contains only no distinctive phonetic features. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 name. The Unicode restoration preserves what can be preserved — honoring the single feature that distinguishes it from plain ASCII.
